apps.name: EeveeSpotify Revived
apps.subtitle: This tweak makes Spotify think you have a Premium subscription, granting free listening, just like Spotilife, and provides some additional features like custom lyrics.
apps.localizedDescription:
This tweak makes Spotify think you have a Premium subscription, granting free listening, just like Spotilife, and provides some additional features like custom lyrics.

---
• Custom Lyrics Support
Spotify 9.1.22 - Full custom lyrics functionality is available with the following provider:
- Musixmatch ✅ (Currently enabled)

• Note:
Other providers (Genius, LRCLIB, PetitLyrics) are available in the code but disabled in build.*

• Difference between non-patched and patched IPA?
Using the patched IPA should fix any widgets issues had when sideloading with paid certs (with app groups entitlement). This fix does not work with free sideloading methods such as AltStore/Sideloadly, and TrollStore users do not need to use a patched IPA.

apps.name: Phim 4K
apps.subtitle: Xem phim 4K UHD mượt như lụa.
apps.localizedDescription:
Phim4K mang cả rạp phim tới nhà của bạn. Kho phim đồ sộ, không quảng cáo, UI thân thiện.

---
Vì sao chọn Phim4K?

• Server siêu tốc
Tối ưu tuyến truyền, CDN toàn cầu. Phát là chạy.

• Chất lượng 4K UHD
Nguồn phim rõ nét, hỗ trợ HDR khi có.

• Không quảng cáo
Tập trung 100% vào nội dung bạn yêu thích.

• Giao diện thân thiện
Dễ dùng, tìm phim nhanh, gợi ý thông minh.
